locator.section: Overview of private market segments and strategies

evidence.excerpt: Private markets offer financing to companies through private equity and private credit, and for real assets (Figure C.1). Private market transactions are mainly conducted via closed-ended funds (“private funds”). Private funds include private equity, private credit and real asset funds.
